svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V4 · NIGHT GLASS CUT
Near-black stage with a faint square grid. A soft green-teal glow begins to open at
the top centre; a few motes of dust catch it.
Fade up from black over 0.6 s; the grid drifts down 1 px/frame (camera slowly
No VO. Music-led, like the reference.
The beam opens fully onto the logo.

g.text: V4 · SHOT 02 — LOGO IN THE LIGHT

svg.text: The beam pours down onto the brew mark and wordmark, centred and glowing. Below, a
dark planet rises into frame; its rim catches the light.
Logo resolves out of a 20 px blur with 105 → 100% scale (e-out, 0.5 s). Planet rises
Soft shimmer as the logo resolves; riser continues.
Camera tilts down: the horizon flares and the product rises behind it.

V4 · SHOT 03 — SUNRISE: THE PRODUCT RISES

svg.text: The horizon flares with a horizontal lens streak. brew Studio climbs up from behind
the planet like a sunrise; the logo has lifted to the top of frame.
Tilt down 300 px with a slight push (e-in-out, 1.4 s). The window rises 360 px from
behind the planet edge; streak flashes on the crest. Ref 0:01–0:01.6 (the dome
Whoosh into a deep, warm hit as the window clears the horizon.
Window settles; the headline lands above it.

svg.text: Hero composition. A glowing orb with the brew mark sits on two light rules. "Stop
assembling videos." in a white-to-mint gradient, "We make them for you." beneath. brew
Studio fills the lower frame with the dome of light behind it. Glass chips (Script,
Voice) and a "New video" card float off its edges.
Slow push-in, ~3% per second. Headline words rise 12 px and unblur with a 60 ms
stagger. Chips drift on separate parallax planes (near ones 2× faster). Ref
Super: Stop assembling videos. / We make them for you.
Beat enters: soft kick and pluck.
Pull back: the window shrinks and a giant brew wordmark appears behind it.
